rooms.label: Entrance Hall
rooms.description: A marble-floored entrance hall. Surveillance cameras sweep the room in lazy arcs. The place looks recently evacuated.

exits.label: head east through the double doors

examineTargets.label: the reception desk
examineTargets.description: A large oak desk. A visitor log lies open — the last entry is dated three days ago. Someone left in a hurry.

examineTargets.label: the security cameras
examineTargets.description: Standard pan-tilt units on a 30-second sweep cycle. You count four covering the hall. Avoid moving when they're facing you.

rooms.label: East Corridor
rooms.description: A long corridor lit by humming strip lights. The air smells of cleaning fluid. At the far end, a heavy door bears a red keycard reader.

exits.label: return west to the entrance hall
take the stairs down to the server room

examineTargets.label: the notice board
examineTargets.description: Maintenance rosters and a fire exit plan. One sheet catches your eye — a handwritten schedule. The overnight guard rotation starts at 0200.

examineTargets.label: the keycard reader
examineTargets.description: A red panel with a slot. Requires a security keycard to unlock the stairwell door.

rooms.label: Server Room
rooms.description: Rows of servers hum in the cold recycled air. LEDs blink in the dark. A terminal in the corner is still logged in.

addenda.text: The download bar on the terminal reads 100%. The files are on your drive. Get out.

exits.label: take the stairs back up to the corridor

examineTargets.label: the main terminal
examineTargets.description: The terminal is unlocked and showing a file directory. Someone left mid-session. The research files are right there.

examineTargets.label: the server racks
examineTargets.description: Dozens of blinking units. Labels suggest this is the primary data store for Project LAZARUS.
